description: This file contains shell functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for a router or embedded device running OpenWrt. It defines methods for checking the image and performing upgrades, along with identifying the platform via the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image; currently always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process based on the board type; defaults to invoking 'default_do_upgrade'.
